## Description
 &#10;&#9;&#9;Liquid crystals are synthetic organic molecules, typically nematic (rod-shaped) compounds. &#10;&#9;&#9;It&#39;s for making LCD screens, temperature sensing, optics, phtonics, smart windows, &#10;&#9;&#9;biomedical/drug delivery, Industrial and Non-Destructive Testing.&#10;&#9;&#9;Carbon ~75–85% of all atoms (~55–65% of molecular mass). Fluorine ~10–15% of all atoms &#10;&#9;&#9;(~20–30% of molecular mass). H + O + N + S for the remainder.&#10;&#9;
